title: Worksheet — Quadratic Equations (Class 10 NIOS Mathematics)
instructions: Attempt all 10 questions. Show every step of your working for the subjective questions; choose the single best option for MCQs. Verify each root by substitution. Total time: 50 minutes.

questions.question: The standard form of a quadratic equation in x is:
questions.explanation: Variable up to second power; a ≠ 0.

questions.question: If b^2 − 4ac > 0, the quadratic has two distinct real roots.
If α and β are roots of ax^2 + bx + c = 0, then αβ = ____.
Solve x^2 − 6x + 5 = 0 by completing the square. Show every step.
questions.explanation: Half the linear coefficient, square it, add to both sides.

questions.question: Use the quadratic formula to solve x^2 − 4x + 1 = 0.
questions.explanation: Plug into the formula; simplify the surd.

questions.question: Find the quadratic whose roots are 2 + √3 and 2 − √3.
questions.explanation: Conjugate roots produce a rational-coefficient quadratic.

questions.question: A rectangular garden's length is 4 m more than its width and area is 192 m². Find the width and length.
questions.answer: Let width = x. Length = x + 4. Area: x(x + 4) = 192 → x^2 + 4x − 192 = 0. Discriminant 784 = 28^2. x = (−4 + 28)/2 = 12 (reject −16). Width = 12 m, length = 16 m.
questions.explanation: Set up the quadratic; reject the non-physical root.

questions.question: The hypotenuse of a right triangle is 13 cm; the other two sides differ by 7 cm. Find the lengths of the two sides.
questions.answer: Let shorter = x, longer = x + 7. Pythagoras: x^2 + (x + 7)^2 = 169 → 2x^2 + 14x − 120 = 0 → x^2 + 7x − 60 = 0 → (x − 5)(x + 12) = 0. Reject x = −12. Sides: 5 cm and 12 cm. Verify: 25 + 144 = 169 ✓.
